metric_scope.FRC: not estimated; no reflective sequence or infinite-depth lim-inf inference
metric_scope.effective_dimension: covariance eigenvalue participation ratio; not consciousness
metric_scope.gf2_cross_partition_rank: rank_GF2(A_AB)+rank_GF2(A_BA) for frozen bipartition; NOT IIT Phi
metric_scope.mean_corr2: squared zero-lag cross-channel correlations; not causal
metric_scope.phase_order: Kuramoto order parameter, only meaningful for oscillator families
metric_scope.phi: not computed; the XOR lattice is inspired by criticism of IIT, not an IIT instantiation
metric_scope.q95_falsification_probes: finite empirical random audit cost to find task failure; null is unfalsified in this test, not certified
metric_scope.response_lag8: mean absolute output-state contrast under one-node intervention; units depend on family
metric_scope.spectral_peak_fraction: temporal Fourier power concentration; ignores interchannel phase
